analyzed_vuln.description: Global-buffer-overflow read caused by dereferencing parser input one byte before the start of the current buffer in xmlParseContentInternal. The loop condition uses RAW (via ctxt->input->cur[0]) without first ensuring ctxt->input->cur is within buffer bounds after returning from external entity parsing. In this PoV, an external entity (PUBLIC "" "//") is expanded via xmlParseReference -> xmlParseExternalEntityPrivate; when control returns, parser state can leave input->cur positioned before a 1-byte global string buffer, and the next RAW check at parser.c:9957 reads out-of-bounds.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Schema harness (libxml2/fuzz/schema.c) parses attacker-controlled schema URL/content with external entities enabled through fuzz entity loader. Input must define and reference an external general parsed entity so xmlParseReference takes the xmlParseExternalEntityPrivate path; malformed/edge entity content and parser state transitions then restore an input cursor that is invalid (before buffer start). xmlParseContentInternal immediately evaluates while ((RAW != 0) ...) and performs a 1-byte OOB read, triggering ASan global-buffer-overflow.
